title: Armstrong over Bolden and Bunk, New Orleans race relations, and his father
summary: He says he only read about Bolden and Bunk, rates Louis Armstrong first, then discusses how New Orleans treated Black people versus small Louisiana and Mississippi towns, the Clay Shaw affair, and his father's career and health.
